run_table_recognition_cli: run the table recognition CLI to detect tables in images or PDFs and output structured JSON results
run_table_recognition_skip_detection: run table recognition with skip_table_detection flag when tables are already cropped from input images
run_table_recognition_highres: run table recognition on input files with high-resolution images for accurate cell and row detection
run_table_recognition_save_images: run table recognition and save annotated images showing detected rows columns and cells as PNG files
run_table_recognition_output_json: run table recognition and write structured results including page table_idx rows cols and cells to results.json
